notes.text:
Primary Care Progress Note
Date: 08/18/2026
Patient: Adrian Wintheiser, 89 y/o M

CC: Back pain

HPI: Back pain since 08/12/2026 after a fall from standing height. No radicular sx noted. No bowel/bladder changes reported.

PE: Tenderness over lumbar paraspinals. No step-offs or deformities palpated. Neuro exam intact distally. Gait steady.

Assessment: Acute lumbar strain post-fall.

Plan: Advise rest, NSAIDs prn, monitor for worsening sx. Follow-up in 1 wk or sooner if new neuro sx develop.

Radiology Report
Date: 09/26/2026
Patient: Adrian Wintheiser, 89-year-old male

MRI 09/26/2026: L1 compression fx, marrow edema on STIR. Interval increase in L1 vertebral body height loss compared with radiographs from 08/16/2026. ~35% L1 height loss. Focal kyphosis L1 22 deg.

No other acute abnormalities identified on this exam.

Spine Intervention Consult 09/29/2026
Pt: Adrian Wintheiser, 89 y/o M

HPI: Outpt, not admitted. NRS 6/10 despite 6 wks NSM (acetaminophen and tramadol, TLSO brace). Pain stable/slightly better. Pain at fx level; afebrile, no infx signs.

Plan: Referred for DEXA + osteoporosis program. Continue current meds and brace. Monitor for any changes or worsening symptoms.

IR consult for possible intervention if pain worsens or new findings.
